correctness.rationale: The final claim is exactly over arbitrary characteristic-three fields k: L=sl3(k) is perfect with center kI3, so the Hom–Jacobi identity forces any Hom–Lie map to preserve that center. The induced psl3 map has 49 coefficients; after removing scalar identity, an explicit 245-by-48 exact F3 system has rank 48 (48-row unit determinant minor in inspected verify.py). I independently reconstructed the commutator structure matrix in the quotient and obtained rank 48, without using its preselected pivot rows. Hence HomLie(psl3)=k id, HomLie(sl3)=k id+Hom(L,kI), dimensions 1 and 9; the minor remains invertible over any char-3 extension field. The two diagonal scalars in the resulting block triangular composition algebra are independent, giving its seven-dimensional square-zero radical, (q-1)^2 q^7 units and 2q^7+2 idempotents. No proof for other characteristic or Lie rank is inferred.
